result.instructions: Tools for Elation Health, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What appointments do we have scheduled tomorrow?"; "List the active problems and allergies for patient Jane Smith."; "Show the visit notes and vital signs for patient ID 123.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Elation Health data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run elationhealth_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run elationhealth_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run elationhealth_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. elationhealth_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: elationhealth_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: Search the practice's patient charts (PHI): id, name, date of birth, sex, contact details, address, status. First and last name match exactly (case-insensitive, no partial names). The SSN is redacted. Elation: GET /patients/.

practice.description: Only patients of this practice id.

last_modified_after.description: Only patients changed after this date or date-time.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous reply's next_cursor, to get the next page.

offset.description: Offset paging instead of a cursor (the reply then has count and next_offset).

tools.name: elationhealth_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Get one patient chart header by id (PHI): demographics, contact details, address, insurance, emergency contact, primary physician, tags. The SSN is redacted. Elation: GET /patients/{id}/.

to_date.description: End of the range (ISO date or date-time).
